access_drivers.description: API access control scheme drivers. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#access_drivers = [ "polkit" ]).

admin_keepalive_count.description: Admin interface keepalive count. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#admin_keepalive_count = 5).

admin_keepalive_interval.description: Admin interface keepalive interval. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#admin_keepalive_interval = 5).

admin_keepalive_required.description: admin_keepalive_required (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#admin_keepalive_required = 1).

admin_max_client_requests.description: Admin interface limit on concurrent requests. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#admin_max_client_requests = 5).

admin_max_clients.description: Admin interface maximum clients. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#admin_max_clients = 5).

admin_max_queued_clients.description: Admin interface maximum queued clients. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#admin_max_queued_clients = 5).

admin_max_workers.description: Admin interface maximum workers. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#admin_max_workers = 5).

admin_min_workers.description: Admin interface minimum workers. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#admin_min_workers = 1).

audit_level.description: Auditing subsystem level: 0 disable, 1 enable if host enabled, 2 enable and exit if disabled. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#audit_level = 2).

audit_logging.description: Send audit messages via libvirt logging infrastructure. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#audit_logging = 1).

auth_unix_ro.description: Authentication scheme for UNIX read-only sockets. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#auth_unix_ro = "polkit").

auth_unix_rw.description: Authentication scheme for UNIX read-write sockets. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#auth_unix_rw = "polkit").

host_uuid.description: UUID of the host. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#host_uuid = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000").

host_uuid_source.description: Source for host UUID: 'smbios' or 'machine-id'. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#host_uuid_source = "smbios").

keepalive_count.description: Maximum number of keepalive messages without response before closing connection. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#keepalive_count = 5).

keepalive_interval.description: Keepalive interval in seconds. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#keepalive_interval = 5).

keepalive_required.description: keepalive_required (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#keepalive_required = 1).

log_filters.description: Logging filters string. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#log_filters="1:qemu 1:libvirt 4:object 4:json 4:event 1:util").

log_level.description: Logging level: 4 errors, 3 warnings, 2 information, 1 debug. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#log_level = 3).

log_outputs.description: Logging outputs string. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#log_outputs="3:syslog:virtnwfilterd").

max_anonymous_clients.description: Maximum length of queue of accepted but not yet authenticated clients. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#max_anonymous_clients = 20).

max_client_requests.description: Limit on concurrent requests from a single client connection. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#max_client_requests = 5).

max_clients.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#max_clients = 5000).

max_queued_clients.description: Maximum length of queue of connections waiting to be accepted. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#max_queued_clients = 1000).

max_workers.description: Maximum number of workers. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#max_workers = 20).

min_workers.description: Minimum number of workers to start up initially. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#min_workers = 5).

ovs_timeout.description: Timeout for Open vSwitch calls in seconds. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#ovs_timeout = 5).

prio_workers.description: Number of priority workers. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#prio_workers = 5).

sasl_allowed_username_list.description: Access control list of allowed SASL usernames. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#sasl_allowed_username_list = ["joe@EXAMPLE.COM", "fred@EXAMPLE.COM" ]).

unix_sock_admin_perms.description: UNIX socket permissions for the admin interface socket. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#unix_sock_admin_perms = "0700").

unix_sock_dir.description: Directory in which sockets will be found/created. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#unix_sock_dir = "/run/libvirt").

unix_sock_group.description: UNIX domain socket group ownership for management access. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#unix_sock_group = "libvirt").

unix_sock_ro_perms.description: UNIX socket permissions for the R/O socket (monitoring). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#unix_sock_ro_perms = "0777").

unix_sock_rw_perms.description: UNIX socket permissions for the R/W socket (full management). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#unix_sock_rw_perms = "0770").
